mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next 20 trading days signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines by >1.5% over the horizon, or the decline does not occur within the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 3.5% in the next month triggers concerns about labor market tightness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 3.5%, or the crossing does not occur within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 260 signals accelerating inflation expectations, prompting market anticipation of rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises >5.0 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260, or the increase does not occur within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in the INDPRO index over the next 5 trading days reflects stronger production capacity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO rises by >2% over the next 5 trading days, or the rise does not occur within the specified period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS above 152,000 signals a robust labor market, fostering confidence in economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises >500 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS crosses above 152,000, or the increase does not occur within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward movement in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (demand) over the next month signals robust demand-side expansion, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and RSAFS rise by >2% over the horizon, or the movements are not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in HOUST (demand) over the next 20 trading days signals reduced consumer spending pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when HOUST declines by >3% during a tightening cycle, or the decline does not occur within the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward movement in both INDPRO (supply) and RSAFS (demand) over the next 60 trading days reflects synchronized economic expansion, strengthening corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both INDPRO and RSAFS rise by >3% over the horizon, or the movements are not concurrent.
